##### Project general facts

Lyvin Gardens is a premium hospitality development by an award-winning Balinese developer renowned for top ratings on leading booking platforms. Located in the sought-after Nunggalan area of Uluwatu, this intimate complex features a curated collection of two-bedroom villas, each with a private pool and parking. Set within a gated tropical park, the project prioritizes spacious gardens and shared spaces for walking and picnics by the river, while ensuring complete privacy for every guest.

Residents and guests enjoy a lifestyle centered around nature and thoughtful design. The expansive grounds include a lush garden for leisurely walks and a dedicated picnic area by the river. A café on-site offers a convenient spot for relaxation. The surrounding neighborhood provides access to international schools, restaurants, concept stores, beauty salons, and a strong European business community. For active pursuits, helipads, paragliding, golf courses, saunas, and scenic hiking trails are all within easy reach.

Every villa at Lyvin Gardens is a masterpiece of understated luxury. The design draws inspiration from New Zealand interior aesthetics, featuring a neutral palette and large windows that create ideal spaces for rest after a sunny Balinese day. Interiors minimize plastic use in harmony with the island's nature. Each villa includes two spacious bedrooms, a generous living room with a fully equipped kitchen, and a terrace with a private infinity pool. Stone limestone partitions ensure privacy while blending seamlessly into the surrounding landscape. 

##### Leasehold
36 + 50 years.

##### Parking

Private and shared parking areas.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the Nunggalan area of Uluwatu within Badung regency, this exceptional location places residents in one of Bali's most prestigious and sought-after districts. The area is characterized by its strong European community and a spirit of collaboration, where neighbors come together to create something special on the island. Land for construction is highly limited here, with only two of the most expensive hotels in Uluwatu located nearby.

The location is distinguished by its natural beauty and exclusive amenities. Just minutes away, visitors can access Nyang Nyang Beach and breathtaking clifftop viewpoints. The area is also home to a concentration of European-owned businesses, including restaurants, concept stores, and beauty salons, alongside an international kindergarten and school within a short drive. For those seeking adventure, helipads, paragliding, golf courses, saunas, and walking trails are all accessible within a short radius.

For those seeking a residence that embodies community, nature, and prestige, Nunggalan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of limited land availability, ocean-view cliffs, and proximity to world-class hotels like Six Senses and Bulgari makes it a top choice for discerning travelers and investors. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of Bali, peaceful, connected, and effortlessly inspiring.
